prompt: Who was the Mayor of Quincy, Massachusetts when the Quincy Medical Center opened and who was the Mayor when it closed?
answer: When Quincy Medical Center opened in **1890**, the mayor of Quincy was **Henry O. Fairbanks**. When it closed in **December 2014**, the mayor was **Thomas P. Koch**.
